thread.title: How to use Nuxt with newrelic node agent
thread.body:
### What problem does this feature solve? Newrelic's node agent has a requirement that it's the first line of your main module in order to properly bootstrap. https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/agents/nodejs-agent/installation-configuration/install-nodejs-agent#installing Currently there's no way to do this in Nuxt's setup. There may also be other use-cases outside of analytics modules, but I can't think of any right now. ### What does the proposed changes look like? Support some way of requiring modules as the first line of the main js entrypoint, perhaps from a hook or something that will be injected in the build step? I would provide code examples but I'm not that familiar with Nuxt internals yet.
This feature request is available on Nuxt community (#c9646)
